items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And I said, well, I didn't come to lead no band, Mr. Rockhead. I can write the music for the band and I don't have to lead it.

ctx.x: Freddie was -- and the scars was in his memory. He was scarred. Very scarred. But he liked me and so he say, Mr. Rockhead says, well, Jacques can lead the band. He said, Jacques is no Canadian, we are Canadian, we don't want him to lead no band." And went into a frantic scene.

And I said, well, I didn't come to lead no band, Mr. Rockhead. I can write the music for the band and I don't have to lead it. I said, well, let Bill lead it. He say, I don't know about leading no band and I said, well, he's the leader -- at least --
I got the band together and I consulted to find out what the people liked because you see we got the French population there so I got a -- I put them all in full dress on Sunday.
